mandates.title: Presidential Facilitation

mandates.description: Ensuring that the Former Presidents and families are well taken care of (Estates & Healthcare).

mandates.description: Translating Cabinet decisions into Government policies and programmes for institutional implementation.

mandates.title: Performance M&E
mandates.description: Monitoring and evaluating the overall performance of the Public Service.

mandates.description: Implementation of the National Decentralisation Policy and functions devolution.
